title: PingCore JoinTicket v1
description: The connect handshake payload a client serialises into NetworkConfig.ConnectionData (https://pingcore.io/docs/fleets/admitting-players). The game server's PingCoreConnectionApproval decodes it and applies the accept matrix before any other work. Player tokens never travel in this payload.
$comment: Size cap: the UTF-8 encoding of the serialised JSON must be at most 1024 bytes, so it fits one Unity Transport packet. JSON Schema cannot express a byte length; the encoder and the decoder enforce it, and every example is checked against it.

kind.description: How the player was sent to this game server. reservation: a Discovery reservation or quick join. match: a matchmaking allocation. backfill: a backfill allocation into a running session. lan: a listen host started with LAN only.

protocolVersion.description: The game's own network protocol version, compared by the game server before it admits the player.

playerId.description: The player id from the player-token response (for example anon:<uuid>).

ticketId.description: Required when kind is match or backfill. Always minted by the SDK as 128 random bits (base64url), never chosen by the caller.

allocationId.description: Required when kind is match or backfill.

displayName.description: Optional name shown to other players.
